[[File:Marisota_Floodplain.jpg|250px|thumb|The Marisota Floodplain in 2974 BBY]]
The '''Marisota Floodplain''' was a flat plain on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] that was situated between the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s capital at [[Tahv]] and the port of [[Eorm]]. During [[Time of the Rot|The Time of the Rot]], it became the site of many battles and campaigns fought between rival Sith factions until the [[Hilts Restoration]] in [[3000 BBY]]. In [[2974 BBY]], it became the site of another battle during [[Remulus Dreypa|Dreypa's]] [[Dreypa's rebellion|rebellion]]. Initially, Dreypa and [[Parlan Spinner]]'s forces held the upper hand against the Tribe until the Tribe's commander [[Grand Consort]] [[Iliana Hilts]] ordered the deployment of the winged [[Skyborn Rangers]]. Dreypa's forces then retreated to [[Sessal Spire]] where he unleashed several hibernating [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]].
